history_anchors._doc: Bruto Sordini: b. Cagli; left law studies for pipemaking; apprenticed at various firms; 1981 breaks from Mastro de Paja with Guidi -> SER JACOPO partnership (1982); 'after a few years' leaves to found DON CARLOS with wife Rosaria (Cagli) -> approx mid-1980s floor, encoded [1984] LOW. Local lineage claim: Primo Soriani, pipemaker near Cagli, early 1900s. House: fully handmade, 2+ yr open-air seasoned briar, UNCOATED chambers (a tell). US intro = 'excellent value' wave. A serious motorcycle accident paused production for years (undated); post-recovery = slower, more deliberate output, new shapes/finishes ('the imaginative musical master is back' — Field; grades named after music: 'due note'/'tre note' trade-known but NOT in our mirror -> unencoded). URBINO = the inexpensive handmade second line. Kronos Quartet connection pictured (musical naming culture).
